title: Shift compatibility of open extension and restriction
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$. For finite-type $k$-schemes $W$ with their small pro-etale sites put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves, with its ordinary unbounded derived category, derived reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]; regard $\mathscr S_W$ as the module category of the ring diagram $((A_n)_W)_n$ on the simultaneous ringed diagram site of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. For a quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow W$, let $J_j:D(\mathscr S_U)\to D(\mathscr S_W)$ be exact termwise open extension by zero and $P_j$ restriction; $J_j$ is left adjoint to $P_j$, using the localized-site extension-by-zero adjunction of [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] on the ringed diagram site. Equip both functors with their termwise cochain-shift comparisons. The unit and counit of $J_j\dashv P_j$ commute with every integer shift, naturally in the system complexes; the assertion is an equality of system maps before finite evaluation and total limit.

proof.text: Use the ordinary exact adjunction a = (o.extension j.left).adjunction retained by Open. Its derived adjunction is definitionally exactDerivedAdjunction a, the localization of a.mapHomologicalComplex at quasi-isomorphisms using the standard exact-functor factorization isomorphisms. No reconstruction from finite evaluations or separate localized-site construction is needed.

The existing proved instance Adjunction.commShift_mapHomologicalComplex_unit in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.MapDerivedCategoryAdjunctionShift verifies the unit shift square degreewise. By Adjunction.localization_unit_app, precomposing the derived unit with DerivedCategory.Q equals the composite of unitors, the localization of this cochain unit, associators, and the inverses of F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and G.mapDerivedCategoryFactors. The Lean proof establishes this equality componentwise with precisely the CatCommSq instances used in exactDerivedAdjunction. Each factor commutes with the existing termwise shifts, so this composite does too. Descend along the essentially surjective DerivedCategory.Q using NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerLeft and the inverse object-preimage isomorphisms.

Apply Adjunction.CommShift.mk' to the derived-unit compatibility. Its unit-to-counit implication proves the counit square for the same fixed termwise shift structures, for every integer shift. These are equalities of transformations of the system derived categories before finite evaluation or total limit.

I rewrote it to apply the lemma level by level on (W_proet,(A_n)_W), with U an object because j is étale. j_! and j^* commute with Res along A_{n+1}→A_n, by def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf, def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification and def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, so they act on systems with levelwise unit and counit.
